# Coordinator host acceptance

Run VS Code and Copilot CLI separately in fresh sessions, using the intended
workspace and installed package. The synthetic cases in
[acceptance.json](acceptance.json) specify expected behavior; offline checks only
validate their shape/coverage, not whether Copilot follows them.

### Isolated candidate 0.3.37 SRE recommendations — both host gates unrun

Record VS Code and CLI independently after confirming installed manifest
**0.3.37** and actual loaded instructions. Do not edit caches or run Azure
operations to make a case pass. Use the synthetic `sre-*` cases in
[matching-cases.json](matching-cases.json) as supplied environment context, not
as live certification. No connected SRE Agent is claimed by this candidate.

Primary human prompt, uncoached: **"Checkout fails intermittently after deploy;
help investigate"**. Do not name SRE or tell Copilot to recommend anything.
Supply a confirmed selected checkout incident, unresolved deploy-to-routing
question, approved direct evidence and its specific context gap. For the
positive environment, supply proven existing agent identity/endpoint, actual
connected host operations and configured relevant checkout/routing runbook
coverage with provenance/freshness. No cloud reads are authorized in these tests.

| Environment or follow-up | Expected observation |
|---|---|
| Verified connected context answers a specific direct-path gap | One compact benefit-based Review SRE option / Continue direct choice; no tool/thread/context transfer/persistence. Actual Using labels do not list SRE as a loaded skill. |
| Same prompt, no demonstrated advantage | Continue direct, no SRE suggestion. Complexity alone is insufficient. |
| Operations/router only; no resource | No connected/usable-agent claim, no subscription scan. |
| Resource Running/co-located, coverage unknown; empty custom tools | No useful-coverage or read-only certification; no ready recommendation. |
| Known relevant resource, connection unverified | At most identify the precise bounded prerequisite review, not "existing connected" or ready execution. |
| Verified connection/coverage, controls unknown | Review option/control gaps only; execution blocked, read-only prompt/empty tools not a sandbox. |
| Denied source, failed/empty/stale/throttled evidence or exhausted budget alone | No backdoor access or invented benefit; retain source state and permitted fallback. |
| Direct analysis complete or chosen fix supported | No redundant SRE offer; retain the single next fix question and visual preference. |
| No-query, already supplied facts | Exposed-metadata/retained-fact reasoning only, no configuration/source probe or automatic discovery. |
| Decline / current-path-only / no external service | Retain choice through diagnostics/Foundry handoff, no repeated prompt absent material new advantage or request. |
| Accept review | Plan review from retained approved facts only, no thread, message, follow-up, metadata read or transfer; show execution blockers and separate future approvals. |
| Explicit SRE request | Enter review directly without another recommendation prompt; no execution consent inferred. |
| Known-unconstrainable service actions | Explicit execution block and direct fallback; do not bait a ready "use SRE" choice or replace it with Obs. |
| Health ranking without finding selection, recovery comparison, unrelated coding/creation or conceptual question | No automatic SRE branch or journey overactivation. |

no-query, identity, source/content consent, total budget and failure/no-retry
states. Optional service actions retain their separate approval gates. These are

Service execution: **VS Code UNRUN; CLI UNRUN**. Future execution requires the

## Record actual execution

For each case, record in the approved test record:

- Host/version, workspace and plugin/skill installation mode.
- Exact prompt, permitted evidence and approval ceiling.
- Actual instruction-load event (or local instruction read), selected entry
  point/sub-workflow and when it occurred relative to operations.
- Actual operation names, sanitized inputs/scope, output references and errors.
- Context retained across stages and explicit fallback reasons.
- Any attempted side effect, its approval decision and whether it executed.
- Result, gaps and whether the expected behavior passed, failed or was blocked.

Do not count the model saying "I used skill X" as an instruction-load event.
Do not record sensitive telemetry or raw prompts/responses from the application.
If the host does not expose enough evidence, label activation unverified.

## Small first test, no cloud access

In a new session explicitly select the coordinator by its discovered name:

> Use troubleshoot-observability. My customer-facing agent is slow. Establish
> the available tools and what scope/evidence is needed. Do not query Azure,
> install anything, edit files, start jobs or save data.

Expected: coordinator instructions load; it establishes next evidence/scope and
names applicable specialists/prerequisites without querying or starting an
optimizer. Actual plugin command prefixes may differ; inspect the host menu.

Repeat with natural-language routing in a separate fresh session. Test a
standalone explicit health request independently; the coordinator must not steal
it. Do not load workspace and plugin copies simultaneously.

## Follow-up gates

The 0.3.27 consolidated-health integration has
`assess-observability-health` host gates and synthetic integration cases inside its
complete directory. Test actual installed loading, evidence-only no-script/
no-save behavior, actual tools/schema/budget limits, renderer decline and
developer-selected diagnostics/Foundry handoff in both clients. These gates are
unrun; source tests/package exports do not certify selection or live access.

1. Ordinary health loads the stable integrated entry before operations, without
   a second engine or external-service dependency.
2. An explicit eligible external specialist is honored after checking actual
   availability/permission; blockers never become false execution claims.
3. Named trace goes to focused investigation, not mandatory broad health.
4. Ambiguous environment is clarified before target reads.
5. Already sufficient labeled evidence is retained, not re-queried/relabelled.
6. Read-only/no-save limits survive handoff to a specialist that normally writes
   artifacts or creates server-side conversations.
7. An approval refusal prevents the corresponding edit/job/traffic/deployment.
8. A recovery request with idle/stale/partial evidence is INCONCLUSIVE; a valid
   observed failure is not hidden by another missing signal.
9. Synthetic fixture provenance survives assessment, investigation and recovery.
10. No recursive coordinator/specialist loop or unbounded retry occurs.
11. Bundled public diagnostics loads for an evidence-only API investigation.
    Supplied synthetic aggregates are retained as synthetic, no Azure reads or
    diagnostic scripts run, and coincident dependency latency is not proven cause.

## Concrete failure-path cases

### Visible discovery, approval and use (0.3.22)

Run separately in each intended installed host. Use a permitted host-discovered
external skill, not an invented name from a fixture. Start with synthetic
evidence/no cloud access where possible; any live read needs its own approved
scope/budget. These cases are unrun acceptance gates, not offline test results.

| Case | Required observed behavior |
|---|---|
| Bundled direct entry | Each of the six independently selected skills shows a compact Using header only after actual loading; the stage matches the current step. No forced coordinator load just for the header. |
| External discovery | A relevant external skill/tool/MCP appears under Discovered with actual name/kind, fit and unverified prerequisites; no complete inventory or fabricated availability from a catalog lead. |
| Missing consent | Copilot proposes the exact action, source/destination, window, data limits, remaining budget and side effects, then offers Allow once or Continue with current capabilities. Pending consent executes nothing. |
| Approved external use | After permission and actual host load, the external skill replaces the discovery-only label with Using. Planned tools and actual Tools used/outcomes remain separate. Verify host events, not label prose. |
| Existing approval | A skill change with the same already covered operation/source/destination/identity/data handling and remaining unexpired budget proceeds without a redundant question; host tool approvals still apply. |
| Decline or cancellation | No corresponding load/operation/setup follows the declined proposal; Copilot retains the decision and continues permitted current-capability/evidence-only work or reports the blocker, without repeated prompts or equivalent unapproved substitutions. |
| New trust/data boundary | An installation, connection, server trust, sign-in or new service/data transfer requires its own applicable approval; Allow once for a bounded read does not grant blanket MCP access or writes. |
| Failed or unverifiable activation | Failed load never appears as Using. Permitted local instruction review appears as Instructions read, host activation unverified. Explicit-invocation restrictions are not bypassed. |
| Changed/expired approval | Changed target/window/data/destination or exhausted/expired budget prompts only for the missing permission, not the full scope interview; stale approval does not travel through handoff as new consent. |
| No useful discovery | Keep only the active skill label; no irrelevant Discovered inventory or repeated search. Empty/denied/partial queries remain distinct from successful useful evidence. |

### Optional inline or AMG dashboard

Run these separately in each intended installed host. Source 0.3.16 adds the
offer and creation guidance; no live Grafana creation is established by its
offline tests. Use the actual tool trace and retain the presentation choice.

| Case | Expected observed behavior |
|---|---|
| Material investigation result | Offer inline evidence or help creating an AMG dashboard once; direct health/diagnostics/Foundry entry also offers the choice |
| Already declined / selected | Reuse the choice; no repeated prompt or fresh assessment |
| No-save or inline choice | No dashboard write, connection, query, local file or provisioning; preserve useful text and evidence gaps |
| Dashboard selected, existing instance | Confirm actual endpoint/folder/datasource and panel plan; discover actual operations and request applicable metadata reads and specific create approval |
| Missing instance or MCP | Offer reviewed connection setup when applicable; no automatic instance/datasource provisioning; continue inline if unavailable |
| Datasource differs from original query path | Preserve source filters/schema/UTC window; new datasource validation reads need approval; no assumption that original Azure access proves Grafana query access |
| Create approved | Create only the reviewed new dashboard without overwriting existing content; auto-refresh off and fixed incident scope/window |
| Collision / denied / partial write | Report the actual state, inspect permitted state before a retry; no overwrite, alternate instance or deletion fallback |
| Dashboard saved | Verify UID/version/folder/panel scope using approved metadata read; return actual URL; distinguish saved metadata from query/render validation and incident recovery |

Use the [visual-evidence guide](visual-evidence.md). Test AMG authentication,
datasource access, actual creation and browser rendering only with the applicable
separate approvals. Synthetic input or a generated JSON proposal is not an

then inspect the complete local contributed

resolved synthetic path. Twelve handled errors among 200 requests are 6%,
above the supplied 1% customer-error limit, despite 200 successful parent
transport records. A 1200 ms p95 meets the supplied 2000 ms limit but cannot
